title: EU enterprises using artificial intelligence
story: In 2025, the EU average showed that 19.95% of enterprises were using at least one AI technology, with Germany at 25.97% and Netherlands at 33.21%. The Netherlands had the highest percentage among the countries studied, showing strong adoption of AI technologies in enterprises.
